$comment: Surfaces of realityarchitect.ai that already work and must be evolved, not replaced. Enforced by scripts/governance/surface-guard.mjs. A change needs a Surface change brief that says how every job survives; `rearchitect` changes and `locked` surfaces also need Frank's surface-approved label. Add a surface when a page proves its value; remove one only with Frank's word. Jobs are matched as words in the brief's Keeps line, so keep them distinct. Estate view: starlight graph/protected-surfaces.graph.json.

surfaces.why: The door to the Reality Architect method: what it is, how it works, and the capture that turns a reader into a waitlist signup. A narrower rewrite that passes its own tests can still erase it (the frankx.ai homepage was replaced exactly that way on 2026-08-27). components/EmailCapture* is the homepage's capture form (also used on /standard and /start).
The site's tokens and type (Tailwind v4 theme in app/globals.css). A change here repaints every page at once.
